Reporting organizationally to the Head of FWWC27 Hospitality Operations, the Hospitality Operations & Infrastructure Venue Manager will help serve Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 that is hosting 32 teams across 8 venues. This role will be responsible for the supervision of the implementation of all stadium hospitality infrastructure requirements and technical operations across all stadiums of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027, and later assuming a fixed position as Rio de Janeiro Stadium Hospitality Operations & Infrastructure Venue Manager during tournament time. She/he will work closely with the Official Hospitality Provider and FIFA’s stadium operations and infrastructure functional areas to ensure contractual and requirements compliance. Key Responsibilities Responsible for the management and operational readiness and delivery of the Affiliates and Commercial Hospitality programmes, reporting duties, maintenance/creation of operational and infrastructure documentations, etc Ensuring Infrastructure readiness and maintenance services of Hospitality areas, in close cooperation with the FIFA other functional areas, the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) and Stadium Authorities Responsible for the on‑site management of the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) and their suppliers, and Hospitality Volunteers Checking and validating the Operational plans from the service‑providing departments to Hospitality (Cleaning and Waste, Security, Medical, Signage, Transport, Fan Operations, Accreditation, Power, IT, TV, ticketing, etc.) Ensuring excellent service to the FIFA Affiliates on site, overlooking the set‑up and readiness of their facilities, monitoring service delivery from the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) from the set‑up phase through to match day delivery of services Ensuring contractual deliverables to the FIFA Commercial Affiliates and to the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) Overall on‑site hospitality guest management Ensure service consistency throughout the different hospitality programmes across all matches in the venue Validating all on‑site hospitality directional signage Ensuring Health and Safety regulations are strictly observed and respected by the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) Ensuring Hospitality guest numbers are updated and shared with all relevant FIFA stakeholders Ensuring that all stakeholders are appropriately accredited. Manage the distribution of SADs (supplementary access devices) to all relevant functional areas, restricting access to hospitality areas as needed Ensure the catering service runs as expected in the Affiliates and Commercial Hospitality programmes Handling all hospitality related issues on Match Day Attend the FIFA Daily Coordination Meeting at the Venue and hold daily Hospitality Team Meetings with the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) Reporting on a daily basis to the FIFA HQ, reporting issues in good time Your Profile Bachelor's Degree or similar level of education in Event Management, Sports Hospitality Management, Project Management, etc. Minimum of 5 years of work experience in stadium hospitality or venue management, managing several venues simultaneously, preferably for major sports or entertainment events. Proven experience with event overlay (including provision of temporary power and water), ticketing, dressing and signage, catering, logistics and security operations Proven experience managing multiple service providers, particularly for Technical services, Cleaning and Waste services, Security Services, Access control Services, Accreditation, etc. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Strong customer‑service attitude, even when under pressure. Ability to work independently and in a team across simultaneous work streams. Exquisite organizational skills. Ability to lead, manage, and motivate a team. Fluent in Portuguese and English. Additional languages considered an asset. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools Excellent knowledge of AutoCAD and literacy of architectural drawings #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Pessoa Captadora de Recursos - Rio de Janeiro
description: Descrição e Responsabilidades MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Em MSF, não toleramos qualquer forma de abuso ou comportamento inadequado, seja em relação a colegas de trabalho, pacientes, doadores ou qualquer outra parte envolvida nas nossas operações. Além disso, buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas. Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans, PcD e pessoas com mais de 40 anos. CONTEXTO DA VAGA A captação de novas pessoas doadoras para a organização é o principal recurso para que possamos atuar nos mais diversos contextos de ajuda médica humanitária ao redor do mundo. Dessa forma, as equipes de captação de recursos são fundamentais para que essa atuação seja realizada, pois é através delas, que se vincula financeiramente novas pessoas a nossa causa. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA CAPTADORA DE RECURSOS EM MSF-BRASIL Trabalhar com Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras é muito mais do que abordar pessoas nas ruas — é ser a ponte entre a organização e aquelas que tornam nosso trabalho possível: as pessoas doadoras. Diariamente, você estará 100% nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro e região metropolitana, abordando ativamente as pessoas para apresentar a missão de MSF e convidá-las a se tornarem doadoras. O trabalho envolve conversar diretamente com o público, explicar o impacto da organização, contornar objeções e garantir novas adesões. Cada abordagem é uma oportunidade de transformar um simples encontro em um ato concreto de apoio às emergências médicas ao redor do mundo. É um trabalho dinâmico, onde cada dia traz novos desafios e aprendizados. O ambiente é sempre coletivo, repleto de troca com a equipe, compartilhamento de experiências e muita energia. Para brilhar nessa função, é essencial gostar de interagir, ser uma pessoa resiliente, comunicativa, carismática e persistente. Afinal, cada novo doação conquistada representa um impacto real na vida de quem mais precisa. Se você busca um trabalho com propósito, movimento e desafios diários, essa vaga é para você! COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO Captar novas pessoas doadoras mensais nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro (trabalho 100% externo), apresentando uma abordagem objetiva e segura, a fim de garantir o ingresso de recursos para MSF. Preservar a imagem de MSF, mantendo uma postura profissional em meio a situações desconfortantes, com intuito de demonstrar segurança e responsabilidade na atuação. Assegurar o cadastro correto das novas pessoas doadoras, preenchendo com atenção e precisão os dados, para garantir o correto ingresso no sistema. Manter-se atualizado sobre as questões que envolvem a Organização, buscando sempre informação junto aos gestores, assim como nas redes sociais, para maior esclarecimento na captação de novas pessoas doadores. REQUISITOS Português fluente. Ensino médio completo ou cursando graduação. Pacote Office básico. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES Experiências com vendas, captação de recursos, telemarketing, atendimento ao público, terceiro setor. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS Gerenciamento de estresse, pois controla reações ultra emotivas e responde com calma. Capacidade de negociação, para comunicar aos outros seus próprios objetivos e demandas. Iniciativa e inovação, para identificar oportunidades e problemas. Flexibilidade comportamental, para adaptar comportamentos às necessidades da situação. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Assistant Director, Alumni Programs
description: Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture A successful alumni relations program depends on a robust strategy to build lasting relationships with alumni and ensure their continued engagement and support. The Assistant Director, Alumni Programs, focuses on developing and implementing centralized engagement initiatives and programs to support the alumni community at Howard University. This role is a key driver in fostering a lifelong connection between the University and its alumni population through educational, professional development, and networking opportunities. Supervisory Authority This position will have supervisory authority over the Manager for Career and Professional Development Manager and the Manager for Reunion Programs. The Assistant Director provides leadership, direction, coaching, performance management, and professional development for these positions; establishes annual goals and priorities; and ensures alignment across program portfolios. Nature And Scope Reporting to the Director of Alumni Relations, this position oversees strategies and long-term projects that aim to cultivate a strong, supportive, and engaged alumni network. The Assistant Director will be a key driver in the growth of centralized alumni engagement through programs, outreach, and volunteer development. This role works closely with the Director of Alumni Relations to develop sustainable alumni programs and execute priorities and will serve as a liaison for internal and external stakeholders, representing the Alumni Relations team through various forms of communication. The position requires collaboration with various campus partners, including the career services and development teams, to ensure alignment of efforts and to promote philanthropic support from alumni. This role is also responsible for overseeing career development opportunities and reunions. Principal Accountabilities The Assistant Director, Alumni Programs, is responsible for the day-to-day operation of long-term alumni programs, focusing on centralized, non-geographical initiatives. This includes planning, developing, and executing programs that provide career readiness and professional development for alumni. The role will manage platforms and projects that facilitate alumni mentorship and networking. The position is accountable for overseeing the planning and execution of all alumni reunions and reunion staff roles. Additionally, the position works alongside the campus partners like the Office of the Secretary, Center for Career and Professional Success, and the Ralphe Bunche Center. A key responsibility includes developing and disseminating engaging content through various channels, including newsletters, social media, and online communities, to keep alumni informed and connected. Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. Relations team and participate in negotiations with DC providers (Equinix, Flexential, Digital Realty, etc.) for rack space, power, PDUs, cross-connects, and cage setup Work closely with the Procurement team to manage hardware and optics procurement — routers, switches, optics, and cabling — track POs, lead times, and delivery schedules Organize and direct smart hands / remote hands for racking, stacking, cabling, and console access setup Ensure every new site has out-of-band management and console access ready before engineering validation begins Track build timelines, dependencies, and risks — keep stakeholders informed with clear status updates Work tightly with Vendor Relations, Procurement, Vendors, and Network Deployment team as your core cross-functional partners Secondary — Network Projects (30%) Manage network expansion projects (new ports, capacity upgrades, additional circuits) — add/replace hardware as needed Coordinate new service and feature rollouts with the network engineering team Support architecture, improvement, scaling, and integration projects What We're Looking For Must-Have 3–5 years of project management experience in IT/telecom, with at least 2 years directly managing data center build-outs or colocation deployments Hands-on experience working with major colocation providers (Equinix, Flexential, Digital Realty, or similar) — you know how to navigate their portals, process cross-connect orders, and manage power/rack allocations Solid understanding of DC infrastructure: rack layouts, power (A/B feeds, kW allocations), PDUs, cabling standards, and cooling considerations Basic networking knowledge (understanding of routers, switches, optics, transit/transport circuits, console access) — enough to have informed conversations with the engineering team and understand what you're deploying Proven ability to coordinate remote/smart hands for physical installations and troubleshoot issues without being on-site Experience managing hardware procurement cycles — POs, lead times, RMA processes Strong communication skills — you can write clear status reports, run effective meetings, and keep multiple teams aligned without hand-holding AI-first mindset (required) — demonstrated experience building workflows, automations, or tools with AI (prompt engineering, AI-assisted coding, agentic frameworks). Surface-level ChatGPT usage is not sufficient; candidates must show real AI work. AI adoption and tool-building is a key component of long-term performance evaluation in this role Nice-to-Have Knowledge of network console/access infrastructure (serial console servers, OpenGear, etc.) Experience with project management tools (Jira, Asana, Monday, Linear, or similar) Familiarity with network validation and turn-up processes PMP, PRINCE2, or similar certification (not required, but a plus) What Success Looks Like New PoP builds delivered on schedule with zero surprises on go-live day Smart hands show up prepared, with the right gear, because you provided clear instructions Network engineers get a site that's racked, cabled, and console-ready — they validate, not troubleshoot basics Procurement and Vendor Relations teams see you as a partner, not a bottleneck Your project documentation is clear enough that anyone can pick up where you left off #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Process Optimization (RTO/ROMeo) & Digital Twin (PST) Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabi[...]
description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted. *** Candidates with Chemical Engineering degree and 17-25 years of experience in Refinery Only*** ***English proficiency (written and spoken) required. Submit CV in English for consideration*** Overview We are seeking an experienced Process Simulation Twin (PST) and Optimization Engineer to join our Reliability Solutions Department (RSD) within our Global Manufacturing Excellence Center. Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME) is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. Your primary role is to deploy and sustain online process simulations (process digital twins), perform process optimization activities to identify opportunities, monitor process performance KPIs and develop advanced process optimization data-enabled solutions. This role sits at the boundary of process engineering and digitalization beyond traditional process simulation roles. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between rigorous thermodynamic models, process digital twins, real-time process data and hybrid analytics through AI. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Lead the development, deployment, and sustainment of PST that integrate real-time process data with rigorous equation-oriented or sequential simulation engines in alignment with corporate objectives. Configure and troubleshoot the connectivity between plant historians, laboratory information systems, and simulation software to ensure seamless data ingestion and reconciliation. Utilize PST to perform automated monitoring of facility health, detecting deviations between ideal performance and actual plant operations to identify opportunity gaps. Develop and maintain thermodynamic models and mathematical equations that accurately represent the behavior of various processes ensuring the PST accurately reflects the current state of the facility (including heat exchanger fouling, catalyst decay, etc.). Perform offline engineering studies using PST to analyze complex operational problems, debottleneck constraints, and conduct "what-if" scenarios based on current operating conditions. Act as the technical liaison between data teams and Operations/Process Engineering teams, leading technical sessions on model architecture, data quality, and commissioning. Lead process optimization sessions to de-bottleneck key process units such as CDU/VDU, Hydrocrackers, Catalytic crackers, Diesel Hydrotreaters, Isomerization. Benchmark process optimization KPIs with 15+ operating facilities and provide development of programs, processes, guidelines and best practices. Provide subject matter expertise to operating facilities Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams by consulting, providing awareness sessions, and participating and leading technical exchanges and conferences. You must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering. You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience in Process Simulations, Online Modeling, or Real-Time Optimization (preferably ROMeo). 20 years of experience is preferred. You will be able to Demonstrate expertise in process engineering and flowsheet-based processes simulation. Preferred Equation Oriented simulation. You will have comprehensive understanding of refinery facilities, feedstock/product movements, margins, giveaways, process yields, and mass and energy balances. Demonstrated experience connecting simulations to live data sources (Data Historians, OPC, etc.). Strong understanding of data reconciliation, model tuning, and dealing with gross errors in industrial data is also required. Work Location and Work Schedule Work location: Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer Work schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer #J-18808-Ljbffr

Conhecimento em métodos como design thinking e ideação. Conhecimento em automação de processos por RPA. Conhecimentos sólidos em gestão de serviços de TI. title: Head of Customer Proposition
description: About the Role We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day. Not remote: This is a hybrid role in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for a commercially driven and customer-centric Head of Customer Proposition to join our Brazil team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the local 360° customer proposition strategy across our core product verticals, including Sports, Gaming and Social . As a senior leader within the Brazil Commercial organisation, you will oversee the ideation, development and execution of market-leading propositions that attract, engage, reward and retain customers throughout their lifecycle. You will lead a team of local product vertical experts and work cross-functionally to ensure our customer experiences are locally relevant, insight-led and commercially impactful. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Brazil, and wider regional and global stakeholders, you will shape and execute the local proposition strategy aligned to broader regional objectives, ensuring we deliver standout experiences that strengthen customer loyalty, increase engagement and drive sustainable growth in the Brazilian market. This role requires a deep understanding of the Brazilian betting and gaming landscape, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for delivering best-in-class customer experiences through innovation, personalisation and operational excellence. What You’ll Be Doing Define and lead the Brazil customer proposition strategy across Sports, Gaming and Social verticals, aligned to wider regional and global business objectives. Develop and execute a local proposition roadmap that enhances customer engagement, retention, cross-sell and lifetime value. Lead and develop a high-performing team of vertical managers/leads, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability and customer obsession. Partner with senior commercial and marketing stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities, market trends and competitive advantages within the Brazilian market. Customer Lifecycle, Retention & Engagement Collaborate with CRM to oversee the development and optimisation of lifecycle and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, retention, reactivation and higher-value segments. Ensure generosity and customer value are delivered effectively throughout key customer moments and major sporting and entertainment events. Drive advanced segmentation and personalisation strategies to create relevant, timely, and differentiated customer experiences. Collaborate with CRM and Performance teams to build sophisticated, data-led communication plans that improve engagement and long-term retention. Commercial Performance & Optimisation Own the proposition bonus and promotional investment strategy across all verticals, ensuring strong budget governance, efficiency and ROI. Monitor and optimise proposition performance against key commercial KPIs including retention, conversion, cross-sell, active days, engagement and customer value. Lead the Test & Learn roadmap for Brazil, identifying and prioritising experiments that improve customer and commercial outcomes. Use customer insights, analytics, and market intelligence to continuously evolve proposition performance and identify new growth opportunities. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Product, GTM, Commercial, BI, CRM, Performance Marketing, Operations and Brand teams to ensure seamless proposition delivery and execution. Ensure alignment between local commercial priorities and the central Sports, Gaming and Social product roadmaps. Support acquisition strategies by optimising propositions and promotional mechanics to improve marketing efficiency and conversion performance. Collaborate with Analytics and Performance teams to build best-in-class reporting frameworks and performance dashboards to inform strategic decision-making. Market & Regulatory Excellence Maintain a strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape and ensure all proposition activity complies with local requirements and responsible gaming standards. Stay informed on competitor activity, customer behaviours and emerging market trends to ensure propositions remain innovative and market-leading. Champion a customer-first approach across all proposition initiatives and touchpoints. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in a senior proposition or commercial leadership role, ideally within the iGaming, sports betting or digital e-commerce/fintech space. Strong knowledge of the Brazilian betting, gaming, and digital consumer landscape. Proven experience building and executing customer proposition and retention strategies across multiple verticals. Strong commercial and analytical acumen with experience managing promotional budgets and performance KPIs. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing and developing high-potential teams and individuals. This role involves direct role management responsibility. Deep understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, personalisation, cross-sell and engagement strategies. Experience leading Test & Learn initiatives and using data-driven insights to optimise customer and commercial performance. Ability to oversee complex cross-functional initiatives/projects to completion and deliver successful business outcomes Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Passion for innovation, customer experience, and delivering market-leading propositions. Preferred Experience Experience across Sportsbook, Casino/Gaming and Social or community-led products. Familiarity with onsite/crm tools, bonus engines, and customer analytics tools. Experience operating within a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment. Understanding of responsible gaming principles and local compliance requirements in Brazil. About Super We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide. Shaping the Future of Play Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page: super.xyz/careers Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA). At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance. This position is based in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. In your daily routine, you will be led 100% in English. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Municipio do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e a integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem-estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público-alvo. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer ações do programa. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internas. description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description: Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding, and non‑competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums. Key Responsibilities Oversee the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during the planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament. Collaborate with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensure that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Work closely with the Non‑Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project. Serve as the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department. Oversee contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites. Constantly monitor the budgetary impact of dressing operations and report updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Provide strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offer expertise when required. Adhere to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Maintain daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaise with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Present to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attend department‑specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Input into the site‑specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management. Act as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project. Participate in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites. Assist with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensure the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites. Contribute to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Possibly relocate to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Minimum 4+ years of experience delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games, etc., or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.). Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑faceted events and projects. Experience managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) in Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs, as the role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems. Will attend site visits and be away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Trophy Tour Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA27 is established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Acting as the central point of coordination in‑market, this role will drive alignment across FIFA’s global project team in Zurich, local stakeholders and all relevant internal functions. Working in close collaboration with the Experiential Marketing Manager in Zurich, the Manager will ensure that all FIFA Trophy Tour activities are strategically aligned, culturally relevant, and delivered to FIFA standards. The role will also support the global leg of the FIFA Trophy Tour where required, ensuring continuity and consistency between international and Host Country phases. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the development and execution of the Host Country FIFA Trophy Tour strategy and marketing approach across Brazil including all Host Cities. Ensure alignment with the overall FIFA Trophy Tour strategy, adapting where needed to maximize local relevance and impact. Integrate with the wider FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project, identifying opportunities to amplify impact across other initiatives. Stakeholder management & governance Manage relationships with Host Cities, local authorities, agencies and key stakeholders, acting as FIFA’s representative in‑market. Maintain consistent alignment and information flow with the Zurich‑based FIFA team, proactively managing dependencies, timelines and decision‑making across global and local stakeholders. Oversee and approve local plans, including venues, run‑of‑show, schedules and promotional activities. Ensure compliance with FIFA rights, brand guidelines and partner commitments. Marketing, communications & content Oversee the development and execution of local promotional plans across channels (digital, media, partners, on‑the‑ground) in alignment with the broader global marketing and communications plan. Ensure Host City activations are culturally relevant, locally resonant and aligned with the overall campaign narrative. Inspire Host Cities and hosts to invest as many resources as possible to deliver the best FIFA Trophy Tour events. Lead coordination of media activities in‑market, approved by the project team and FIFA Communications. Oversee content capture, approvals and distribution across FIFA channels and stakeholders (including .com, CRM, VNRs and social platforms). On‑site delivery & operations Represent FIFA on‑site across selected FIFA Trophy Tour stops in Brazil and support on global stops if needed. Global coordination Support the Zurich‑based project team on the global leg where required. Coordinate with FIFA27 Government Relations to pitch FIFA Trophy Tour opportunities to Brazilian Government representatives and embassies for inclusion in both phases of the tour to facilitate their involvement in official events and support local engagement opportunities.
